verdict.rationale: Outlook's own Graph mail API lets a user or app delete messages and attachments, and choose whether a sent message is saved to Sent Items. That gives basic, direct control over deleting mailbox data. Nothing in the evidence covers retention control itself, such as retention periods, automatic purge policies, or account-level data deletion. missing for 10: configurable retention policies or durations, guarantees on permanent deletion or purge (including from DeletedItems), account or data-deletion controls, privacy-posture documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Draft, read, reply, forward, send, update, or delete messages
